ShipConstructor

ShipConstructor supports detailed shipbuilding design and production information on an AutoCAD platform.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Develop a production model

Begin with the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended ShipConstructor preview, develop a production model; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Route ship systems

Use the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended ShipConstructor preview, route ship systems; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Create fabrication drawings

Start from the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended ShipConstructor preview, create fabrication drawings; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
